scheme_name: Tripura Scheme For Incentive To Girl Child
other_conditions: Up to two girl children per mother in each BPL family.
Girl child must be born on or after 01/06/2009.
Application must be submitted to the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) of the concerned AMC/Nagar Panchayat/RD Block using the prescribed application form.
benefits_summary: ₹300 per month per girl child up to age 15, paid to the mother via bank or post office account.
